tool_policy.paid_tool_fallback: Adobe or other paid tools were not used; they remain optional quality/final-pass fallback paths only with explicit BK approval.
tool_policy.transparent_asset_method: Sprite and UI assets were generated on chroma_key #00ff00 and processed with the imagegen remove_chroma_key helper via uv run --with pillow.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D side-scrolling platformer background, Section 1 warmup. Primary request: Create an original launch-quality candidate background for a 2D indie platformer prototype. This is Section 1, a calm warmup traversal area. Scene/backdrop: a lucid-dream workshop ruin with simple stone floor silhouettes, soft teal twilight, distant soft geometric arches, subtle painterly depth, clear horizontal side-scroller readability, no characters. Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D game background, clean silhouettes, production-candidate quality, original visual language, not imitating any named artist or franchise. Composition/framing: wide 16:9 side-scrolling game background, stable horizon, playable floor area visually clear along the lower third, parallax-friendly layers, no UI. Lighting/mood: calm, readable, inviting, low contrast behind gameplay area. Color palette: cool teal, muted blue, soft moss-gray stone, gentle warm highlights. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no famous characters, no copyrighted IP, no photorealism, no extreme detail clutter, no foreground objects blocking the lower gameplay band. Avoid: menus, icons, text labels, player character, enemies, weapons, gore, brand marks.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D platformer controllable player sprite candidate. Primary request: Create a single original controllable player avatar for a 2D indie platformer, readable at small scale. Subject: a compact dream-workshop traveler character with a simple blue cloak, small lantern charm, round readable silhouette, friendly but adventurous, no weapon. Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D game sprite, clean silhouette, production-candidate quality, original design, not imitating any named artist or franchise. Composition/framing: single full-body character centered, neutral standing pose facing right three-quarter side view, generous padding, no ground plane. Lighting/mood: soft readable rim light, simple forms, strong contrast against background. Color palette: blue cloak, muted warm accent, no bright green. Transparent workflow source: Create the subject on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #00ff00 color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no weapon, no combat pose, no famous characters, no copyrighted IP, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection. Avoid: extra characters, enemies, UI, background scenery, photorealism, tiny details that disappear at small scale.
